# ⚡ NeuralOps v1.3.3: Kernel Acceleration & SVD Optimization

## 🌟 Highlights
- **Activation-Aware SVD (AA-SVD)**: Gradient-free second-order sensitivity approximation for SVD truncation.
- **Iterative Truncation Engine**: Optimal rank budget distribution across multi-layer transformer blocks.
- **Triton JIT Acceleration**: Early Triton JIT kernel integration for fused prefix scans and fast attention.
- **Throughput Profiling**: Benchmark harnesses comparing tokens/sec across quadratic vs subquadratic models.

## 📦 Installation
```bash
pip install neuralops==1.3.3
```
